semantic_reason: Issue #1335 reports that with duplicate subscriptions on the same field_key/topic, unsubscribing one removes both registry entries because Registry.unregister was called with only the field_key. The one-line patch in lib/absinthe/subscription.ex changes Registry.unregister(registry, field_key) to Registry.unregister_match(registry, field_key, doc_id), scoping removal to the specific doc_id so only the intended subscription is unregistered. This corrects existing erroneous behavior rather than adding new functionality, and the added test 'can unsubscribe from duplicate subscriptions individually' verifies the fix.
delegation_note: Defect-semantics review remains agent-delegated; patch minimization was separately confirmed by the human dataset curator on 2026-09-12.
